info.name: Better app menu
info.summary: Show apps as icons in the header
info.description:
Shows apps as drag&drop sortable icons in the header, in the style of the navigation bar from Nextcloud 33 and earlier. Anyone who prefers the current menu can switch back to it.
- Icons that do not fit go into one "More apps" menu and return when the header has room again. - Administrators set a default order and can keep chosen apps in the overflow menu. - Each user inherits that default until they save their own order, rearrange icons, or hide apps in the overflow menu. - The original apps menu keeps Nextcloud's own order.
info.author: Timo Triebensky
